doc_layout.docs/configuration.md: Single JSON config reference. Sections: 'Config ownership', 'Config file', 'Local dev', 'Secrets', 'Settings reference' (with subgroup tables: Top-level, Server, Langfuse/tracing, etc), then per-feature sections. Settings-reference tables use one row per JSON key (key | type | default | description).
doc_layout.docs/architecture.md: System architecture. SSE/attachments section describes image handling: handed to llmio build_agent(images=...) seam; Claude passes native image blocks; text-only OpenRouter models get injected ask_image tool from tier config vision binding. 'Other Endpoints' table documents /history compaction metadata (compacted_summary, compacted_turn_index, compacted_summary_missing).
doc_layout.docs/changelog.md: Thin pointer to repo-root CHANGELOG.md (release-please auto-generated; do NOT hand-edit).
doc_layout.docs/user-guide/chat-interface.md: UI features. 'Compacted (Summarised) Sessions' section documents the three compaction metadata fields and UI handling: summary card + toggle, and graceful-degradation/banner patterns for compacted_summary_missing:true.
doc_layout.docs/user-guide/deployment.md: End-to-end deploy guide. 'Compacted sessions and the missing-summary flag' subsection (inside 'Conversation history across restarts') carries JSON examples for flag present/absent. Sections numbered (## 8. Updating, ## 9. Mobile SSO with 9.x subsections); ordered-list rule uses '1.' for all items.
doc_layout.docs/api/: mkdocstrings stubs only (robotsix_chat.md, mobile-sso.md) — NOT prose docs for /history. mobile-sso.md documents the mobile SSO auth API.
doc_layout.docs/user-guide/settings-ui.md: UI settings panel. 'Editing periodic-session presets' section: the UI preset editor exposes EXACTLY FIVE fields (name, initial_prompt, schedule_interval_seconds, model_level, enabled) — it does NOT render/edit anchor_utc, and savePresetForm replaces the whole preset object (so an anchor_utc would be dropped if a preset were edited via UI). Reference line points to periodic-sessions.md for the full key reference.
doc_layout.docs/periodic-checks.md: User-facing guide to periodic subsessions (periodic checks). Contains a spawn_subsession parameter table (kind/title/instructions/model_level/interval_seconds/anchor_time/max_runs/auto_stop_no_change_runs/include_previous_result/dedup_key) under '## Setting up a periodic board check' — this table mirrors the tool's optional params and MUST be updated in step with the subsessions skill.md when spawn_subsession params change. Row cells use trailing-space padding to align closing pipes; edit via the unique '| `max_runs`' cell anchor.

conventions.config_key_docs: New config keys documented in 4 places: (1) config/config.json (committed default template, periodic.sessions is an EMPTY array placeholder), (2) config/config.schema.json (schema for periodic nested models like PeriodicSessionDefinition; generated externally via robotsix_config CLI, not in-repo), (3) docs/configuration.md Settings-reference table row, (4) src/robotsix_chat/config/settings.py (class docstring + Field description). Nested-model keys (e.g. anchor_utc on PeriodicSessionDefinition) are documented in the schema description + config/periodic_models.py Field description + docs prose, not settings.py.
conventions.secrets: JSON Schema type string with writeOnly:true = SecretStr (never logged, redacted in trace output).
conventions.changelog: CHANGELOG.md and docs/changelog.md are release-please auto-generated; no manual edits.
conventions.ordered_lists: Use '1.' for every ordered-list item in docs/ (mdformat --number pre-commit flattens sequential 2., 3. back to 1.). Avoid sequential numeric lists.
conventions.periodic_anchor_utc: periodic preset anchor_utc (ISO 8601 UTC instant) anchors the schedule: fires at the anchor and every schedule_interval_seconds thereafter; legacy unanchored cadence is first-run-promptly-then-spaced. Normalised to explicit UTC in periodic_models.py field_validator (naive=UTC, offsets converted). Serialised to ISO string in periodic_definitions_list_endpoint (JSONResponse has no datetime encoder). Docs: docs/configuration.md table row + docs/user-guide/periodic-sessions.md bullet.
conventions.history_schema: No OpenAPI/Swagger spec file exists in this repo. The authoritative /history response schema lives in the history_endpoint docstring in src/robotsix_chat/chat/server/routes/sessions.py, backed by prose in docs/architecture.md, docs/user-guide/deployment.md, and docs/user-guide/chat-interface.md. No compaction runbook/wiki exists (only an unrelated mobile-SSO runbook).

image_vision.vision_model_key: Config key `vision_model` (string, default openrouter/openai/gpt-4o-mini, advanced:true). Empty string = 'vision model unconfigured' -> curated no-image-support failure path. Code exposes Settings.vision_model_configured property (bool).
image_vision.architecture: Attachments via llmio build_agent(images=...) seam; Claude native image blocks; text-only OpenRouter models get injected ask_image tool from tier config vision binding.

history_compaction.flag_semantics: compacted_summary_missing:true appears EXACTLY when compacted_turn_index>0 but no usable compacted_summary (never persisted or empty). Never-compacted sessions return only 'turns'. Implemented in src/robotsix_chat/chat/server/routes/sessions.py history_endpoint. Schema lives in the endpoint docstring (no OpenAPI file).
history_compaction.docs_locations: history_endpoint docstring (sessions.py, schema+examples), docs/architecture.md (Other Endpoints table), docs/user-guide/deployment.md (JSON examples present/absent), docs/user-guide/chat-interface.md (client-handling patterns: summary card+toggle; graceful degradation / banner on missing flag; must not render empty summary card).

periodic_docs.anchor_utc_locations: PeriodicSessionDefinition.anchor_utc. Docs already updated: config/config.schema.json (schema + description), docs/configuration.md (Settings-reference table row + example), docs/user-guide/periodic-sessions.md (key bullet + calendar-agenda example + endpoint prose). settings-ui.md intentionally unchanged (UI does not edit anchor_utc). Code: src/robotsix_chat/config/periodic_models.py (model+validator), src/robotsix_chat/periodic/scheduler.py (_next_run), src/robotsix_chat/chat/server/routes/sessions.py (ISO serialisation).
periodic_docs.spawn_subsession_anchor_time: Subsession spawn_subsession tool gained optional anchor_time (subsessions/schedule.py, worker.py validation, worker_periodic.py _anchored_next_run_at). Surfaced in subsessions/skill.md, tools.py docstring, AND docs/periodic-checks.md parameter table. Default tz UTC; IANA optional; DST: whole-day intervals hold local wall-clock constant.
